objective: Test whether a compact conditional diffusion model over interpretable morphology sequences learns real-cave along-route transitions better than matched independent and coherent statistical controls while retaining the CW11 hard projection and offline-cache runtime architecture.

frozen_input.split_unit: entire named cave system and acquisition campaign

read_only_sequence_audit.adjacency: Consecutive registered rows, center distance at most 2 source voxels, absolute tangent dot product at least 0.5, and both radial profiles valid.
read_only_sequence_audit.decision: Use masked variable-length sequences. Never pad short sources and describe them as measured long-range evidence.

sequence_dataset.descriptor: CW11 mean log radius plus six complex gravity-anchored Fourier modes.
sequence_dataset.condition: Registered CW7 context only; no cave identity embedding so a held-out cave does not require an unseen embedding.
sequence_dataset.masking: Right padding is zero and excluded from normalization, loss, attention-free convolutional state, and metrics.
sequence_dataset.source_balance: Each training step draws the same number of sequences from every training cave with replacement.
sequence_dataset.normalization: Descriptor and context mean and scale are estimated from the eleven training caves inside each fold only.
sequence_dataset.tiny_source_policy: Report per-source sequence counts and uncertainty. Lauiloch and other tiny sources remain valid cave-level folds but cannot support a long-range claim.

registered_arms.independent_null: Training-source-balanced Gaussian descriptor distribution with zero temporal correlation.
registered_arms.coherent_ar_control: The same training-source-balanced Gaussian distribution with per-channel AR(1) correlation estimated from adjacent training pairs.
registered_arms.conditional_sequence_diffusion: Masked conditional one-dimensional denoising diffusion over the entire descriptor sequence.
registered_arms.measured_reference: Held-out real sequence descriptors, accessed only by evaluation after inference.

model.architecture: Non-causal dilated residual Conv1D denoiser with pointwise context conditioning and sinusoidal diffusion-time embedding.

training.precision: bfloat16 where supported; loss and optimizer state float32
training.checkpoint_selection: Final EMA checkpoint only; no held-out metric selects a training step.
training.gpu_policy: Idle guarded CT221 GPU lane only, immediate preemption on terrain demand, one GPU process, no Aero access.

evaluation.safety_evaluation: Sample fixed Natural graph contexts, project with the unchanged CW11 projector, compile the exact field, then re-run route, port, forbidden-rock, volume, seam, and maximum-displacement gates.
visuals: blind held-out measured versus independent versus AR versus diffusion sequence strips
same-route Natural versus AR versus diffusion compiled 3D volume

failure_policy.diffusion_loses_to_coherent_ar: Close learned result negative and retain the coherent statistical process without a neural product dependency.
failure_policy.tiny_sources_dominate_fold_count: Report both all-source and at-least-eight-sequence sensitivity analyses; do not silently drop sources from the primary result.
failure_policy.safety_failure: Fail closed regardless of distribution metrics or visuals.
failure_policy.performance_failure_quality_pass: Keep diffusion as offline research generator only and retain precompiled-cache product path.
failure_policy.post_validation_threshold_or_step_tuning: Forbidden; any recovery requires a new preregistration.

claim_limit: Twelve named development caves test a constrained conditional sequence-diffusion mechanism. They do not estimate a universal cave population, prove causal speleogenesis, or validate another geology or game without separate evidence.
